benchmark: OAEI Conference track (ra1), learned pairwise matcher

protocol.outer: leave-one-pair-out (21 folds) and leave-one-ontology-out (7 folds); held-out TP/FP/FN summed (micro)
protocol.supervision: reference alignments of the training pairs only (positives) + all other same-kind cross pairs (negatives)
protocol.inner_selection: decoder in ['mutual', 'greedy', 'hungarian'] x threshold in [0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.45, 0.5, 0.55, 0.6, 0.65, 0.7, 0.75, 0.8, 0.85, 0.9, 0.95, 0.96, 0.97, 0.98, 0.99] chosen on 2 inner splits of the training pairs by micro-F1 M3

headline: logreg

published.aggregation: micro (absolute TP/FP/FN across all 21 test cases)
published.note: ra1 is the original crisp reference alignment; the organisers' headline table is rar2-M3 (consistency- and conservativity-repaired), which we do not vendor and therefore do not report numbers against.  OAEI 2024 published only rar2-M3 for the Conference track.
